provenance.purpose: Shared public copy for timyeou.com resume routes and the GitHub Pages readable resume. Detailed evidence remains in source/resume.md.

name: Timothy Yu

availability.en: Open to Senior iOS opportunities in Taichung
availability.zh: 歡迎洽談台中 Senior iOS 職缺

summary.en: Senior iOS engineer with 10+ years in mobile development. Built real-time WebSocket betting for SportyBet (about 100K DAU) and multi-protocol Earn and Buy & Swap for Crypto.com Onchain (about 20K DAU), plus connected vehicle features, from product and API discussions through production support. Additional React Native experience on the pre-launch Cronos App.
summary.zh: 具備 10 年以上行動應用開發經驗的資深 iOS 工程師。負責 Crypto.com Onchain 多協議 Earn 與 Buy & Swap（約 2 萬 DAU）及 SportyBet WebSocket 即時投注（約 10 萬 DAU），並開發聯網車輛功能，與產品及後端團隊協作至上線及維運；另於上線前的 Cronos App 使用 React Native 開發 Earn 頁籤。

bullets.en: Owned iOS Earn across multiple blockchain protocols, including delivery, maintenance, and refactoring.
bullets.zh: 負責跨多個區塊鏈協議的 iOS Earn 功能交付、維護與重構。

bullets.en: Delivered Buy & Swap, extending fiat purchase with a user-initiated on-chain swap after funds reached the wallet. Built staking, unstaking, rewards, and position-management flows.
bullets.zh: 交付 Buy & Swap，在法幣購買資產到帳後，由使用者啟動鏈上兌換；並實作質押、解除質押、獎勵領取與部位管理。

bullets.en: Worked with Product and Backend teams through planning, API discussions, and production delivery for Onchain, a wallet with approximately 20K DAU during my tenure.
bullets.zh: 與產品及後端團隊協作規劃功能、討論 API 並交付正式版本；Onchain 在任職時約有 20K DAU。

bullets.en: Investigated crashes, rendering delays, and API latency using Firebase Crashlytics, Firebase Performance, and Datadog; used Segment for analytics and A/B testing.
bullets.zh: 使用 Firebase Crashlytics、Firebase Performance 與 Datadog 調查崩潰、畫面延遲和 API 延遲，並使用 Segment 進行分析與 A/B 測試。

bullets.en: Built the Earn tab in React Native and TypeScript using Fabric and TurboModules.
bullets.zh: 使用 React Native／TypeScript 與 Fabric、TurboModules 開發 Earn 頁籤。

bullets.en: Implemented wallet signing, UserOperation construction, and Morpho deposit, withdrawal, and position flows; validated multi-step transactions on Cronos Testnet with mocked vaults.
bullets.zh: 實作錢包簽署、UserOperation 建構及 Morpho 存入、提領與部位流程，使用模擬 Vault 在 Cronos Testnet 驗證多步驟交易。

title.zh: 客戶：KINTO · 正式 iOS App

bullets.en: Delivered vehicle usage tracking, vehicle status, and in-app guidance during a three-month contract, collaborating with Product, Design, and Backend teams.
bullets.zh: 在三個月約聘期間，與產品、設計及後端團隊協作，交付車輛使用紀錄、車況資訊與 App 內操作引導。

bullets.en: Built live odds, open bets, and betting-history synchronization with WebSocket; prevented duplicate updates across multiple betting slips. SportyBet had approximately 100K DAU during my tenure.
bullets.zh: 使用 WebSocket 建立即時賠率、未結算投注與投注紀錄同步，避免多張投注單重複接收更新；SportyBet 在任職時約有 100K DAU。

bullets.en: Adapted Android-first requirements into native iOS flows and migrated legacy modules to RxSwift and MVVM.
bullets.zh: 將以 Android 為主的需求轉成原生 iOS 流程，並將既有模組遷移至 RxSwift 與 MVVM。

bullets.en: Built an internal mock server for UI development and automated testing; investigated issues with Firebase and Elasticsearch logs, reviewed PRs, and mentored junior engineers.
bullets.zh: 建立供 UI 開發與自動化測試使用的內部 mock server，使用 Firebase 與 Elasticsearch 紀錄調查問題，審查 PR 並指導初階工程師。

bullets.en: Served as the primary iOS developer and managed client projects from planning through enterprise internal distribution, coordinating Product, Backend, and Android teams.
bullets.zh: 擔任主要 iOS 開發者，管理客戶專案從規劃到企業內部分發，協調產品、後端與 Android 團隊。

bullets.en: Developed video-streaming apps with encrypted HLS playlist playback.
bullets.zh: 開發影音串流 App，支援加密 HLS 播放清單。

bullets.en: Led a three-engineer iOS team delivering enterprise apps, internal distribution, and release coordination.
bullets.zh: 帶領三人工程團隊開發企業 iOS App，負責內部分發與發布協調。

bullets.en: Conducted client requirements interviews and business development; independently delivered apps with scanning, vehicle rental, Bluetooth, and media features.
bullets.zh: 負責業務開發與客戶需求訪談，獨立交付掃碼、車輛租賃、藍牙及媒體功能的 App。

bullets.en: Independently built logistics tracking and packaging-monitoring apps with Swift and SOAP APIs.
bullets.zh: 使用 Swift 與 SOAP API，獨立開發物流追蹤和包裝監控 App。

scale_note.en: DAU figures describe approximate product scale during my tenure, not growth attributed to my work.
scale_note.zh: DAU 為任職時產品的概略規模，並非個人創造的使用者增長。

skills: Swift · UIKit · SwiftUI · RxSwift · Combine · Swift Concurrency · MVVM

skills.en: EOA & smart contract wallets · Transaction signing · Wallet SDK integration · Staking & vault integrations
skills.zh: EOA 與智慧合約錢包 · 交易簽署 · Wallet SDK 整合 · 質押與 Vault 整合

skills: Xcode · Git · GitHub Actions · Firebase · Datadog · Segment · Elasticsearch

bullets.en: Building a native Swift/SwiftUI iOS app that turns natural-language requests into editable preparation plans. TypeScript supports schema validation and evaluation tooling.
bullets.zh: 以原生 Swift／SwiftUI 開發 iOS App，把自然語言需求轉成可編輯的準備計畫；TypeScript 用於結構驗證與評估工具。

bullets.en: The private prototype saves the original request locally and presents AI output for review; users can still save their input when AI is unavailable.
bullets.zh: 私人原型會在本機保存原始需求，讓使用者檢視 AI 建議；AI 無法使用時仍能保存輸入。

title.en: Development task & handoff tools · Personal tool
title.zh: 開發任務與交接工具 · 個人自用

bullets.en: Built a private React/JavaScript workspace with Node.js CLI/HTTP/MCP ticket tools. Public companion tools provide context handoff, task estimation, and read-only run monitoring.
bullets.zh: 建立私人 React／JavaScript 工作空間，搭配 Node.js CLI／HTTP／MCP 任務工具。公開 companion tools 提供脈絡交接、任務估時與唯讀監控。

workflow.en: Used AI for task decomposition, implementation support, and code review at Crypto.com. Personally validated UI, network behavior, and failure states, adjudicated review comments, and requested code-owner approval before release.
workflow.zh: 在 Crypto.com 使用 AI 協助拆解任務、實作與程式碼審查；親自驗證 UI、網路行為及失敗狀態，判斷審查意見，並在發布前送交 code owner 核准。

education.en: National Taipei University · Bachelor of Business Administration
education.zh: 國立臺北大學 · 企業管理學士
